result.description: Sales-focused CRM for managing deals, contacts, pipelines and activities.
result.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 auth-code for apps registered in Developer Hub (client_id/secret); personal API token via x-api-token header for single account.
result.access_detail: Developer sandbox account via form gives Developer Hub access and OAuth client_id/secret for private/dev apps. Publishing publicly on Marketplace requires app approval. Sandbox deleted if inactive. No plan restriction on API found in pages read (not proof of absence).
result.api_notes: REST JSON, v1 and v2 OpenAPI specs. Covers Deals, Persons, Organizations, Leads, Activities, Pipelines, Products, Projects, Webhooks, Users, etc. Official SDKs (Node etc.).
result.blocker: Public distribution of own OAuth app needs Marketplace approval; otherwise none.
